name: Kuuhaku
description: Read-only architecture map for coding agents: which repository calls which HTTP route, with file:line on both sides, plus queues, gRPC links, shared databases, env key names and the repos that read a model's field. Answers from the graph.json a local kuuhaku scan wrote, or, with a login token, the workspace graph on api.kuuhaku.dev. All eight tools are read-only (readOnlyHint: true): no shell, no file writes. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: All eight tools (repos, repo, who_calls, impact, connections, queue, search, field) are read-only (readOnlyHint: true): they answer from the loaded graph and never run a shell or write files.
Launch with --graph <file> (npx kuuhaku mcp --graph ./graph.json) to serve one local graph with no network calls; without --graph or a login token it serves the latest local scan.
Results quote route paths, repository names and README openings from the scanned repositories; scan only repositories you trust.
Pin the package version when launching via npx (npx kuuhaku@0.2.9 mcp) so only the reviewed release runs.
Review any tool outside these eight.
